name: EMPIAR-10076
title: L17-depleted 50S ribosome assembly intermediates, the dataset of cryoDRGN's tutorial
notes: Every particle is in one stack, named .mrc. Its header states the space group of a stack of images, 0, so vitrio reads it as a stack as it is.
Parameters.star has the poses and the CTF of the particles, as cryoDRGN's tutorial uses them.

variants.name: D=128 and D=256
variants.recipe: cryodrgn downsample L17Combine_weight_local.mrc -D 128 -o particles.128.mrcs, and -D 256. The stack does not fit in the memory of most machines, so downsample it before converting it.

variants.name: float16 on disk
variants.recipe: python examples/python/basic/convert.py particles.128.mrcs particles.128.f16.mrcs --data-type float16, on a downsampled stack: the converter reads a file whole.
